run_comms_utils_tests: run the unittest test suite for comms_utils parsing and bandwidth calculation functions
test_parsesize: test the parsesize function to parse size strings like 2GB or 3MB into bytes
test_parseRankList: test the parseRankList function to parse comma-separated or range rank strings into lists
test_getAlgBW: test the getAlgBW function to calculate algorithmic bandwidth from elapsed time and data size
test_getSizes: test the getSizes function to generate size lists using step factor or step bytes
